It might accept a single string or an array of strings? The example says "Cafe"[] meaning array of "Cafe"? But maybe they want to pass an array of facilities. Let's assume we pass an array of strings: ["Reading Room", "Fiction"].

Similarly for Los Angeles: location "Los Angeles, CA", facilities: ["Wi-Fi", "Children Section"].

Chicago: location "Chicago, IL", facilities: ["Cafe", "Reading Room"].
